evidence: Swap (fail): put a seed library or a council equipment-hire desk into this frame and every identity-carrying element survives: system-like geometric sans in one voice, off-white grey-green ground, one dark-green accent on buttons, bordered white cards, a 16px line-art wrench beside the name. Only the copy (tool names, deposits, 'returned when it comes back clean and working', '14 Mill Lane') is bound to Fernhill.

Category-guess (fail): predicted default for a community booking/library catalogue is a light ground, one 'trustworthy' green or blue accent, a search bar over a two-column card grid with thumbnails and availability pills, a month calendar for dates and radio cards for slots. find 1280-light matches every item; the predicted opposite (dark, hushed) is just the dark theme of the same frame.

Similar-prompt (fail): a brief for a toy library or a community-garden equipment shed would land on the same choices: wrench/leaf icon + name, identical icon-placeholder thumbnails, green 'Available from' chips, calendar with 'Open' markers, check-and-confirm summary box. The overlap is near total.

No signature: the closest candidate, the pick-up calendar marking 'Open' sessions (tool day-chosen 1280-light), is the category's standard availability calendar, and on the find page every card repeats the same wrench placeholder tile rather than the tool.

evidence: items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light: ten identical wrench placeholder tiles dominate the left of every card; the green chip is the only colour.
basket default 1280-light and done 1280-light: short pages with an empty grey band under the footer; a half-width box beside full-width boxes.
